result.summary: Found a few visual issues, mainly around clipped/overlapping scrollable content and fixed navigation overlaying the feed.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the content feed. The second restaurant card in “Popular right now” is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom nav, making the image and controls feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The category chips row shows a partially cut-off pill on the far right, which looks accidental rather than like a deliberate horizontal carousel.
issues.suggestion: Either ensure the next chip is visibly scrollable with a clear partial preview/fade, or adjust spacing so only complete chips are shown.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel cuts off the third restaurant card and its title at the right edge. This may be intended as a horizontal scroll preview, but it appears visually cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase right padding, use a cleaner carousel peek, or add a subtle scroll affordance so the clipping feels intentional.
